findings.title: Raw private text can leak through excluded-row identifiers into shared report artifacts
evidence: ValidateRows calls ValidateRunnableRow only for USER_ADAPTIVE_EVAL_ONLY rows.
The copied-text/private-marker validators are inside ValidateRunnableRow.
BuildExcludedPair copies excluded-row ScenarioId, PairId, and non-empty EvidenceScope into pair_results.
pair_results are written to report JSON and Markdown.
findings.why_it_matters: Excluded rows are shared evidence context. They are not scored, but they are still emitted. Review question 2 requires raw private sentinel text to be blocked/redacted before shared JSON, JSONL, Markdown, and evidence.
required_fix: Validate all input-derived strings that can be emitted for every route before BuildReport, not only USER_ADAPTIVE_EVAL_ONLY.
At minimum, apply ValidateCopiedText to scenario_id, pair_id, and any non-empty emitted evidence_scope for all rows.
Apply the same rule to any future emitted excluded-row fields, or avoid copying unvalidated excluded-row input into shared reports.

Add targeted tests for EVIDENCE_ONLY and COMMON_BLOCKED rows with raw private markers in emitted identifiers/scope, asserting EVAL_ONLY_INPUT_VALIDATION_FAILED and no JSON, JSONL, or Markdown report files.
Add a negative CLI/shared-artifact scan for excluded-row sentinel text.
